svg.title: The Ranger's Book 3: only the counts are left
svg.desc: The logbook on the other side: every name and site number has gone and the rows have not closed up, so only the persons counts remain, in arrival order. On the facing page Tam has drawn each count as a tent pad with that many trees in it, and pencil lines tie rows to glyphs: the counts are trees.
svg.text: 19 down to 1, the way the loop went.
